messages:
jess_marketing: Quick sync — LumenWorks customer story timeline. We have the recorded interview from yesterday and we need final quote confirmations + legal sign-off before Wed EOD so we can publish next Tuesday.

sam_seo: Got it. I'll draft the SEO-forward headline options tonight and push a short list by 9am. Any specific metrics we want to highlight?

maya_cs: Recommend calling out 3x inference throughput and 42% cost reduction vs previous infra. Need to verify with LumenWorks before we publish. @oliver_pm do you have the benchmark link?

oliver_pm: Yup — here's the perf doc (internal): `drive.redwood/lumenworks/benchmarks/2026-03-18.md`. Numbers recorded under the "steady-state" test. I'm double-checking the latency p95 right now.

lena_design: I'm blocking time to assemble the press kit assets. Can someone confirm final logo variant (wordmark vs full lockup)? LumenWorks sent two files: `LW_logo_v1.svg` and `LW_logo_v2.svg`.

jess_marketing: Use v2 lockup, please. Also include a short pull-quote from the CX lead: "Redwood cut our inference costs in half while improving response consistency." We'll request approval on that exact wording.

dylan_ops: Quick ops note — if we mention the dedicated deployment config we should scrub any internal IPs or private S3 paths before release. I'll run a grep/replace pass and share the sanitized artifact.

maya_cs: Reaching out to the customer now for quote sign-off and release form. Template: `marketing/release-form-v3.pdf`. @legal_bot can you confirm any extra clauses needed for EU customers?

legal_bot: For EU-based customers we include the data processing addendum and require checkbox consent for publishing specific revenue or contract-level details. Also: no language implying joint endorsement beyond a quote. I'll attach the checklist.

sam_seo: For the headline options I'm thinking: 1) "LumenWorks scales realtime inference with Redwood — 3x throughput" 2) "How LumenWorks cut inference costs by 42% with Redwood" 3) "From pilot to production: LumenWorks' path to predictable LLM serving" Thoughts?

jess_marketing: I like option 2 for the blog, 3 for the case study landing page, and 1 as a social lead. Keep them consistent with approved quote language.

oliver_pm: FYI, one benchmarking caveat: the 3x throughput is vs their previous mixed-CPU/GPU setup, not vs competitor X. We'll add a parenthetical in the methods section.

lena_design: Draft of the one-page PDF is up at `design/marketing/lumenworks-1pager-v0.1.pdf`. Feedback welcome. I left space for a stats box (throughput / cost / latency).

maya_cs: Customer replied — approved the quote but asked to soften "cut our inference costs in half" to "significantly reduced our inference costs". They signed the release form and attached the signed PDF. Uploading now.

jess_marketing: Good catch. We'll use the softened language. @sam_seo adjust the headline to avoid the explicit percent if possible.

sam_seo: Updated headline options: 1) "LumenWorks scales realtime inference with Redwood" 2) "How LumenWorks significantly reduced inference costs with Redwood" 3) "From pilot to production: LumenWorks' path to predictable LLM serving"

dylan_ops: Sanitized artifacts shared at `s3://redwood-marketing/lumenworks/sanitized/`. I removed internal hostnames and the perf run IDs.

legal_bot: Received signed release form. All clear on legal side for publishing in NA/EU. Keep a copy of the signed PDF in the PR.

jess_marketing: Next steps: Sam finalizes SEO headline + meta, Lena finalizes assets, I'll write draft case study and pull quotes, Maya will own customer approval thread. Target: internal review by Fri 3pm PT. Anyone blocked?

lena_design: No blockers from design. Will upload final assets by Thu 5pm PT.

maya_cs: No blockers — customer confirmed schedule for the social quote and review window on Fri.

oliver_pm: I'll annotate the perf appendix and hand off to Jess for any technical LSIs.

jess_marketing: Awesome — thanks team. I'll spin the draft tonight and open a PR. Please add any nitpicks there. :thumbsup:
